title: Bermuda Triangle compass deviations from ancient meteorites

tellings.quote: my personal belief is that there were probably in ancient ancient ancient times metal uh meteorites that landed under the ocean floor

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who has worked with NASA, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, his own theory about the Bermuda Triangle, a stretch of ocean off Florida known for stories of compasses going wrong and ships and planes going missing. Rogers says his personal belief is that, in very ancient times, metal meteorites landed and now lie under the ocean floor there, throwing compasses off. It would offer a natural explanation for the area's strange reputation.
